items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 79:1
items.html: For the HGT of the level of AB of AVI were made of two phases: of the three lower thirds that remained of the HGT of AA, and of the three upper thirds that ascended to them from the NHY of AA, as is known. And the Tifferet includes within it Hesed and Gevura; hence this Tifferet is called by the name of Vav, for the six phases mentioned above. And the Mochin of ZA are made not merely of the NHY of AA, but of the NHY that ascended and became HGT. We find that the three Mochin of ZA were made of the lower half of the Vav, namely of the three upper thirds of the NHY of AA that ascended and became HGT; and the upper half of the Vav, namely the three lower thirds of the HGT, remained as the phase of HGT, for the need of AVI themselves. (Item 58).
